news.text: "CONDEMNED TO WIN"#Juve will restart from #Cagliari (8:45 PM): #Spalletti restores the pride."They don't rank us among the favorites? We don't care at all: there is no break for those who have made the bianconero choice, we raise the bar ourselves". Then he pokes #Kolo, #Zhegrova and #Koopmeiners. Interview with Fonseca: "It's nice to see #Cagliari so high up. But #Juve must always win the scudetto".[Front Page TuttoSport]

Happy birthday, to the one and only, Beppe! Who day in, day out brings us closer to our beloved Juve. Stand every day behind his desk to inform us & entertain us. Who will always be there to put us back on our feet after a loss. Who will dance when we win a game & dye his beard white when we win a Coppa Italia. Have a great day Beppe! 🤍🖤Lets show him some love! 🙏🏻

🇮🇹⁉️ #Ekhator aims to return between the end of October and early November: #Spalletti is waiting for him to evaluate his qualities. He is the only physical striker in the squad and could represent the exact profile requested. He will have his chances to convince the manager and also influence the winter mercato session. #Juventus believes in him, but does not rule out a loan until the end of the season.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

Luciano Spalletti's side travel to Sardinia to take on Cagliari on Matchday 6.The clash is set to kick off at 20:45 CEST on Sunday, October 11, and it will see the Bianconeri take on one of Serie A's most in-form teams.Head coach Luciano Spalletti spoke to the press to preview the action.THE BREAK AND THE TEAM’S CONDITION"The break has been a long one, and there are pros and cons. 🇦🇷⚡️ #Juventus is ready to reopen the #Tagliafico track, as he remains a priority to reinforce the left flank. He was just one step away on the final day of the summer mercato, but the deal fell through due to #Cabal's failed sale. He would represent an ideal solution thanks to his international experience, charisma and solid defensive qualities. He thus remains at the very top of the list.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤❌️ #Neto will miss the match against #Cagliari due to a one-match suspension picked up during his time at #Botafogo and it has not yet been served. The Brazilian will return to being regularly available for #Spalletti starting from next match.[TuttoJuve via @AverageJuventinoGuy]
✅‼️Good news from the treatment room for #Juventus. Augusto #Owusu is shaking off the injury that kept him sidelined. His return is expected in a few days.[Mirko Di Natale]

🇮🇹🔛 #Juventus is accelerating for #Romano, aiming to beat the competition as early as January: first phone contacts have taken place between #Carnevali and Giulini. The bianconeri would be ready to offer around €25M, but it might not be enough. #Cagliari would like to postpone everything until the summer. #Inter is also still in the race, looking especially at June. #Milan, on the other hand, appreciates him, but for now has not initiated concrete contacts.[Daniele Longo - CM•COM via @juventusinsidernews]
